sections.label: Intro
sections.intent: Sparse arpeggiated D and A chords, gentle pick, light sustain

sections.label: Verse
sections.intent: Fingerpicked pattern on D-A-Bm-G, medium articulation, rests between phrases

sections.label: Chorus
sections.intent: Strummed open voicings with syncopated upstrokes, fuller but not power chords

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.intent: Similar fingerpicking to verse but with small variation in turnaround, added lower passing note

sections.label: Bridge
sections.intent: Sparse arpeggios over Bm-G-D-A, drops to low register, leaves space for cello

sections.label: Final Chorus
sections.intent: Strummed chords with a high D drone on top, slightly denser than first chorus, extended chord on last bar

tracks.name: Brush Kit
tracks.instrument_hint: jazz brush kit: snare, kick, hi-hat, ride cymbal

tracks.name: Warm Keys
tracks.instrument_hint: electric piano with soft pad, tremolo optional
